description: Baseline: the built-in ILLUSTRATIVE analysis example, unchanged.
Brick supply crisis: R-MAT probability 0.8, longer worst-case delay, no stock on site.
Labour shortage: only 3 of 6 workers available; R-LAB 0.7, R-SKILL 0.5.
Heavy monsoon: R-WX probability 0.6 and delay 2 / 5 / 10 days.
Well-managed site: every risk probability scaled by 0.4.
Everything goes wrong: every probability and every delay scaled by 1.5 (p capped at 0.95).
Tight deadline (17 days) with a high liquidated-damages rate (20,000 per day).
Delay is cheap: cost per delay day 800 and damages 500 per day.
Every candidate response costs four times as much as in the baseline.
Relaxed deadline (30 days): the planned duration is 16 days.
